title: Molty display v2
description: What a skill draws on Molty's round screen: display.yaml (or display.json) next to SKILL.md. Guide: docs/DISPLAY.md. Units never change: a distance is a fraction of the screen's radius (1 reaches the rim), an angle is degrees counter-clockwise from 3 o'clock, a time is seconds from the screen's start.

$schema.description: Where this schema lives, for editors that read JSON.

molty.description: Always display/2. Tells tools which schema applies.

assets.description: Which files in assets/ the package carries, in this order. An asset is named by its file name without the extension; two files with the same name are an error. The device holds at most 64.

data.description: Fixed tables the compiler repeats over with for (the twelve signs and their angles). Built into the package; the agent never sends them.

parts.description: Reusable groups of shapes, placed in a screen with use. The compiler writes them out in full: a part costs the same items as writing it by hand.

additionalProperties.errorMessage: a screen is written here (about, draw, ...) or is a path like screens/chart.yaml

screens.description: Every screen by name, at most 32. The name is what the agent sends as layout in scene.play. A value is the screen itself, or the path of a file in screens/ that holds it.

name.errorMessage: must be a snake_case name: a lower-case letter, then up to 23 of a-z, 0-9 and _

screen_name.errorMessage: must be a lower-case name: a letter, then up to 23 of a-z, 0-9, _ and -

binding.description: A whole value read from an input ("{{ value }}") or, inside a for, from the element ("{{ body.angle }}"). Quote it. Never part of a longer text, never a formula.

num.errorMessage: must be a number or a quoted binding like "{{ value }}"

size.description: A fraction of the screen's radius, a name from tokens.sizes, or a binding.
size.errorMessage: must be a number (a fraction of the screen's radius), a size token or a quoted binding like "{{ value }}"

width.description: Line width: hairline (0.012, one braille dot: crisp), thin (0.03, the default), bold (0.06), a name from tokens.lines, a number or a binding.
width.errorMessage: must be hairline, thin, bold, a line token, a number or a quoted binding like "{{ value }}"

color.description: A token (ink, grid, dim, white, erase, or one from tokens.colors), #rrggbb in lower case, or a binding. erase clears what is under it. Default white.
color.errorMessage: must be a color token (ink, grid, dim, white, erase or one of your own), #rrggbb in lower case, or a quoted binding like "{{ value }}"

place.description: center (the middle of the glass, the default), { x, y } (right and up are positive; one left out is 0), or { angle, distance } around the centre.
place.errorMessage: a place is center, { x, y } or { angle, distance }

from.description: Seconds into the screen when it appears. Left out: from the start.

until.description: Seconds into the screen when it goes. Left out: until the end.

show.description: When the shape is on screen, in seconds from the screen's start.

group.description: A name a tap zone can light with highlights. A binding works: "{{ aspect.id }}".
group.errorMessage: must be a name (1 to 24 of letters, digits, _ and -) or a quoted binding like "{{ body.id }}"

only_when.description: Hidden until its group is lit by a tap, then fades in.

move.description: Slide along keyframes. Needs firmware that is not out yet: the compiler refuses it. Until then repeat the shape with for and show.

id.description: The install id and the file name: packages/<id>/<id>.json.
id.errorMessage: must be 1 to 32 of a-z, 0-9 and -

version.description: X.Y.Z. Raise it whenever the built package changes, so Moltys that have it update.

about.description: One line for the catalog: what the package adds, for an agent to pitch it to its human.
about.errorMessage: must be one line of 1 to 160 plain ASCII characters

fallback.description: What the agent does on a Molty without screens: speech (say it instead) or none.

colors.description: Named colors, used wherever a color goes.

lines.description: Named line widths, used as width.

sizes.description: Named distances, used as radius, size, length or distance.

tokens.description: The skill's own named colors, line widths and sizes, added to Molty's built-in ones (ink, grid, dim, white, erase; hairline, thin, bold). A token may not reuse a built-in name.

files.description: Several files: * matches inside a file name (sorted), {a,b,c} lists alternatives in that order. assets/signs/*.svg, assets/maps/{sun,moon}.png.

as.description: symbol: one color, takes the color of the shape that draws it (SVG lines, or a PNG's opaque pixels). picture: keeps its own colors, up to 15 and see-through (PNG). map: a picture wrapped round a globe, twice as wide as tall (PNG).

pixels.description: Size on the device: a width (the height keeps the aspect) or [width, height], at most 128. Needed for an SVG. A PNG is used at its own size: leave it out, or state the size to have it checked.
pixels.errorMessage: must be a width from 1 to 128, or [width, height]

stroke.description: SVG lines drawn this thick, as a fraction of half the drawing's width (the same way a distance is a fraction of the screen's radius). Left out: the SVG's own stroke-width.

smooth.description: true: each SVG polyline is drawn as a smooth curve through its points, like a line shape with smooth. Default false.

asset_group.errorMessage: names its file (file: assets/logo.png) or files (files: assets/signs/*.svg)
asset_group.description: One or several files in assets/ and what they become.

row.description: One element of a data table: a flat object of numbers and texts.

with.description: The values the part takes, with their defaults. Inside the part "{{ name }}" reads one.

about.description: One sentence: what the screen shows. Goes into build/display.md for the agent.

duration.description: Seconds, or hold (until replaced or the command's ttl_s runs out). Default hold.
duration.errorMessage: must be seconds (0 to 600) or hold

subtitles.description: Where a tap's reading and the agent's words show: bottom (the default), middle, or a y from -1 to 1.
subtitles.errorMessage: must be bottom, middle or a y from -1 to 1

inputs.description: What the agent sends with scene.play, at most 8. Every input must be sent and must be used.

screen.description: One screen: what the agent sends and what Molty draws.

type.description: number; angle (degrees, -720 to 720); distance (fraction of the radius, 0 to 2); amount (0 to 1); seconds (0 to 600); text (words for a label, up to 40); reading (what a tap shows, up to 160); color (#rrggbb); asset (an asset's name); groups (group names, spaces between, up to 4); list (up to 32 flat objects, see of). path needs firmware that is not out yet.

about.description: One sentence for the agent: what to send and how to work it out.

sent_as.description: The name the agent sends, when it differs from the name used here: symbol in the drawing, g in what is sent.
sent_as.errorMessage: must be 1 to 24 of letters, digits, _ and -

example.description: A value that works. Fills the sample call in build/display.md and the preview.

max.description: A number's largest value; a text's most letters; a list's most elements (default 32). The compiler budgets the screen with it.

of.description: For a list: the fields of each element, at most 12. For an asset: the folder its files are in (assets/planets).
of.errorMessage: must be the fields of each element ({ angle: { type: angle, about: ... } }) or, for an asset, a folder like assets/planets

default.description: Needs firmware that is not out yet: the compiler refuses it. The agent sends every input; put the usual value in example.

about.description: One sentence for the agent: what to send and how to work it out.

sent_as.description: The name the agent sends, when it differs from the name used here.
sent_as.errorMessage: must be 1 to 24 of letters, digits, _ and -

of.description: For an asset: the folder its files are in.

field.description: One field of a list's elements.

draw.description: Shapes, painted in order, later ones on top.

for.description: Repeat the shapes in draw for each element: "body in bodies". bodies is a list input (repeated on the device) or a data table (repeated by the compiler). Inside, "{{ body.angle }}" reads a field.

with.description: Values for the part. A binding passes an input through.

entry.errorMessage: an entry draws one thing: one shape (circle, arc, ticks, spoke, line, dot, globe, symbol, label, tap_zone, beat_clock, wheel, centre_tap), or for with draw, or use (with with)
entry.description: One shape (its name is the key), a for block, or a part placed with use.

start.description: The angle it starts at. Default 0.

end.description: The angle it ends at, counter-clockwise from start. Default 360.

arc.description: Part of a circle, from start to end.

count.errorMessage: must be a whole number from 1 to 120 or a quoted binding

radius.description: Where each mark starts, from the centre.

length.description: How long each mark is, outward; negative runs inward. Default 0.1.

first_angle.description: The angle of the first mark. Default 0.

ticks.description: Evenly spaced marks round the centre of the glass.

radius.description: Where it starts, from the centre. Default 0.

length.description: How long it is, outward; negative runs inward. Default 0.1.

spoke.description: One mark at an angle from the centre of the glass: a pointer, a planet's tick.

points.description: 2 to 16 places joined in order, instead of from and to.

smooth.description: true: a smooth curve through the points. Default false: straight segments.

line.errorMessage: a line has from and to, or points (not both)
line.description: Straight segments, or a smooth curve through the points. A point read from inputs must be { x, y }.

dot.description: A filled circle. color: erase cuts a hole in what is under it.

map.description: The map asset it wears (an asset with as: map), or a binding. Left out: a plain ball in its color.

lit.description: How much of it is lit, 0 to 1. Default 1.

lit_side.description: Which side is lit. Default right. From an input: a number, 1 for right or -1 for left.
lit_side.errorMessage: must be right, left or a quoted binding to a number (1 right, -1 left)

spin.description: Degrees per second it turns. Default 0.

globe.description: A shaded sphere wearing a map: Moon phases, planets. Its dark side hides what is behind it.

asset.description: An asset's name (its file name without the extension), or a binding.

size.description: Its width; the height keeps the aspect. Default 0.12.

symbol.description: An asset: a symbol takes the color given here, a picture keeps its own.

text.description: Up to 40 plain ASCII letters, or a binding to a text input. A screen shows at most 40 letters in all. Words and an input cannot be mixed: send the finished text.

label.description: Words in the device font, centred on at.

at.description: The centre of a round zone.

along.description: Instead of at: the zone is the band within radius of the segment from to to. A line to tap along.

radius.description: How far from at, or from the segment, a tap still counts.

reads.description: What Molty shows at once when tapped, word by word, with no round trip: up to 160 plain ASCII characters, or a binding to a reading input.

id.description: Names the zone in the tap event the agent gets.

highlights.description: Group names to light, spaces between, at most 4; or a binding. Left out: whatever is drawn inside the zone.

grow.description: How much what it lights grows, 1 to 3. Default 1.25.

width.description: Degrees wide, half to each side of where the zone is (at).

inner.description: Where the wedge starts, from the centre of the glass. Default 0.

from.description: The angle the wedge starts at.

to.description: The angle it ends at, counter-clockwise from from.

sector.description: The zone is also a wedge of a ring round the centre of the glass: a whole slice to tap. Either { from, to, inner, outer }: from one angle to another, between two distances (then at and radius may be left out); or { width, inner, outer }: so many degrees wide around where the zone is, for a zone placed by an input. A tap right on a zone's own circle or line beats a tap that only falls in a wedge.
sector.errorMessage: a sector is { from, to, inner, outer } (two angles and two distances) or { width, inner, outer } (degrees wide around the zone's own place)

screen.description: The screen to open: its name, or a binding to a text input.

seconds.description: How long it stays, 1 to 600, when it is a held screen. Left out: until a tap beside it.

opens.description: A tap opens another screen of this package over this one, on Molty itself, and comes back when it ends or at a tap beside it. Write the screen's name, or { screen, seconds }. The opened screen's inputs are found by name: in the tapped element first, else among this screen's inputs; a list passes on only the elements whose `of` is this zone's id.
opens.errorMessage: opens is a screen's name, or { screen, seconds }

tap_zone.description: Nothing visible: a place to tap. Round (at and radius), along a segment (along and radius), or a wedge of a ring (sector). Overlapping zones: the smallest wins, then the nearest.

radius.description: The outer drum's ring. The others sit at 0.75, 0.525 and 0.3375 of it, the step marks just outside it.

dot.description: A hit's dot. Default 0.057 of radius.

beat_clock.description: The rhythm Molty's beat player holds, drawn as a clock from the speaker's own clock: a ring a drum, a mark a step, a dot a hit, the hand, each hit swelling as it sounds, the count-in, the phrase, the name. A tap on a dot mutes that drum. One a screen.

id.description: Names the wheel in the ring event the agent gets when it settles.

grab_from.description: A touch from this far out turns it. Default 0.85.

by.description: What a click adds to the value. Default 1.

fast.description: What a click adds turning fast (over 200 degrees a second). Default by.

face.description: 0: up at first; 1: up after a tap on the centre_tap.

sets.description: tempo: the value is the beat player's tempo, at once. pick: the wheel steps through the beat player's rhythms and plays the one chosen.

labels.description: A list input whose elements each have a label: the wheel steps through them, one bead each, instead of a number.

wheel.description: A ring at the edge the finger turns, in clicks, on Molty itself: a number, or a choice among labels. Each click ticks the motor. One a face.

radius.description: The zone round the centre. 0.26 keeps clear of a clock's third ring.

back_after.description: Seconds untouched on face 1 before it flips back (with the choice). Default 4.

centre_tap.description: A tap in the middle flips the wheel to its other face; on face 1 a second tap, or back_after seconds, makes the choice.
